name: Chat Utils
description: Chat quality-of-life for Minecraft: mention alerts with per-keyword colours and sounds, chat heads, word filter, timestamps, clickable links with a domain allowlist, long searchable history with export, hidden chat and peek, macros, a chat calculator, ~3900 Unicode symbols with :name suggestions, 16 message fonts, Twitch and YouTube chat in game, translation, chat bubbles, auto-reply, unsigned chat and optional end-to-end encryption. Client-side only.
